issues: One key point is wrong: it calls 593 a table, but 593 is the ID of the Change Log Setup (Table) List page. That page and the field list page use the system tables AllObjWithCaption and Field as their sources.
The post is about setting up the change log through configuration packages, which is administration work, not development. The development system is dropped.
The summary, the objects and both quotes match the post.
